card.name: Start of DUPIXENT/DUOPA brand names
card.fires_on: The first piece "DU" of brand names like DUPIXENT, DUOPA and DUAKLIR, right after verbs or phrases like "dosage of", "discontinue" or "administer". Also fires on the space before a dose number and on the end of "Dexamethasone".

modes.label: DU at start of brand name

card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of brand names like Dupixent when a sentence is about giving or stopping the drug.
